application.name: Quality Assurance / Control Dashboard - Rework Analysis

comment: This pipeline reuses config/settings.json's paths.quality_upload_folder and input_files.rework - see src/quality/reader.py. It reads the same Production Rework Data workbook that also feeds the PDQC override in the Projects pipeline (src/merge.py -> apply_rework_pdqc_override()); nothing new needs to be uploaded for this dashboard beyond that one workbook, in data/upload/quality/.

publishing.comment: When true, every run also copies the quality bundle (see output_files.bundle above) into paths.website_data_folder - the file website/quality.html auto-loads for every visitor of the hosted site, same pattern as config/production_settings.json.
